plainText:
Ditto (Japanese: メタモン Metamon) is the main protagonist of . Taking the form of a human, Ditto uses its abilities of to imitate the moves of certain other Pokémon it meets, with the goal of creating a paradise.

==In the spin-off games==
===History===
====Background====
Prior to the disappearance of humans, it was the partner of a Pokémon Trainer who traveled the Kanto region with it. One day, when practicing transformation, it surprised its Trainer by transforming into them. This is the same form it takes in the present day. 

====Pokémon Pokopia====
Ditto finds its 's old Pokédex, with a picture of its Trainer petting Ditto. Upon discovering the device, Ditto proceeds to copy the appearance of its Trainer, setting off on its own adventure. With the help of various Pokémon, Ditto is able to use to replicate certain moves and collect materials such as lumber and s to create a paradise for it and the other Pokémon it meets. 
 

===Appearance===
Visually, Ditto appears identical to other members of its species. Unusual of its species, Ditto tends to maintain its humanlike form by instead making alterations to specific sections of its body that are necessary for imitation, such as transforming its arms into plant stems to use . However, it does take on the form of , , , and when imitating their respective moves. In all transformations (save for objects imitated through ), it retains the face of a Ditto.

===Personality and characteristics===
As a Pokémon, Ditto is capable of understanding the speech of other Pokémon; by listening to the wants and likes of the Pokémon on the island, Ditto uses its power of mimicry to create a habitat that best suits the nearby residents. From this, it appears to be a benevolent Pokémon dedicated to using its powers to restore the environment for the Pokémon which reside there. In its dialogue options, Ditto tends to mimic the speech patterns of the Pokémon it is speaking to.

While it appears to be a typical Ditto while untransformed, Professor Tangrowth frequently mentions that it has a "mysterious power" to bring Pokémon together. Unlike most Ditto, this Ditto seems more adept at maintaining human form and using human tools, such as kitchenware, and is clever enough to realize recipes on its own. It was noted by its Trainer to be quite curious in nature, particularly about humans and their activities. On the other hand, when into other Pokémon, Ditto usually only transforms a part of its mimicked human body to use moves. When it does fully transform, it tends to appear more diminutive and cartoony compared to its target.

==Other appearances==
===Pokémon GO===
From March 10, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., to March 16, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. local time, as part of Pokémon GO's Pokémon Pokopia Celebration Event , which was based on , several Pokémon based on those encountered in the game appeared more frequently in the wild, in , from Field Research tasks, from Timed Research, and from Collection Challenges, with Costumed Ditto wearing either a hat or a cap, based on the hat and cap that Ditto can wear in Pokémon Pokopia, appearing in the wild as various Pokémon, and from completing Collection Challenges.
